views.observation: Smooth under all five policies. No new visible texture or seam.
The narrow cables and small braces stay soft across policies. The main beam stays continuous.
Leaf silhouettes persist across the grid changes. Fine subdivisions stay soft.
The visible diamonds and crossings persist. The tiny green point below the fence is still present.
The nominal left stays mottled. The vertical bar remains visible and most lattice crossings are unresolved at both exposures.
Some right diagonals persist across policies. The thin diagonal traces around the cable stay incomplete.
Transferred conditioning reveals weak lower-left traces. Changing overlap does not create coherent intersections beside the bar.
Transferred right diagonals are the clearest. The 32-pixel output is a little darker and the gaps in crossings persist at both exposures.
Window bars hold across the policies. Very fine horizontal cables and masonry stay softer than the exact target.
The saturated yellow background and the shoulder or sleeve tones differ from the exact target across the five policies. The two shorter overlaps show similar contours.
The saturated magenta sign keeps its shape and color at display x1.
The warm halo of the distant pinpoint lamp has different strength and extent.
The bright display keeps its red outline. The small adjacent glyphs vary in brightness and color.
